title: InstructPix2Pix: Learning to Follow Image Editing Instructions
layout_note: Two columns split by a thin vertical rule: the left two-thirds, titled Training Data Generation, stacks three grey rounded strips (a) Generate text edits, (b) Generate paired images, (c) Generated training examples; the right third, titled Instruction-following Diffusion Model, is one grey panel (d) Inference on real images.
grouping: Each sub-step (a)-(d) is a light-grey rounded panel with a bold lettered title at its top left; the two halves get bold centred titles above them and a thin vertical divider between them. Models are the only coloured shapes.
shapes_depth: Flat: models (GPT-3, Stable Diffusion + Prompt2Prompt, InstructPix2Pix) are light-blue rounded rectangles with no outline; text inputs and outputs are written in italics as quoted strings with roman labels (Input Caption:, Instruction:, Edited Caption:); images are real photos in pairs. Arrows are short slate-blue lines.
proposed_highlight: The paper's model InstructPix2Pix appears only in panel (d), as a light-blue box between a real painting and its edited version under a quoted instruction; the data-generation half credits existing tools (GPT-3, Stable Diffusion + Prompt2Prompt) in boxes of the same blue.
lesson: When the contribution is a generated dataset plus a model, give the data pipeline lettered strips stacked on the left and the model a single tall panel on the right, and draw every example as real quoted text and real image pairs.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2211.09800); venue remembered as CVPR 2023 (not printed on the arXiv first page). Most of the crop is embedded photos (recorded by refs crop).

arrangement.units: Two titled halves divided by a thin vertical rule; the left half holds three stacked grey rounded strips (a), (b), (c), the right half one grey rounded panel (d); every panel has a bold lettered title at its top left.
arrangement.inputs_as: quoted italic captions and instructions; real image pairs (generated) and a real painting at inference
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn; training of the model is only stated in the caption

taxonomy.task: instruction-based image editing trained on generated paired data

insights.structure: Left two-thirds: three lettered grey strips stacked top to bottom (text edits, paired images, training examples); right third: one tall grey panel for inference, with a thin vertical rule between the halves.
insights.data: All text is shown as real quoted strings ('photograph of a girl riding a horse' -> 'have her ride a dragon') and all images as real before/after photo pairs, four pairs in a row in strip (c).
insights.emphasis: The contribution is shown by example rather than by structure: panel (d) is the largest and holds a large before/after painting pair with the InstructPix2Pix box between them.
insights.flow: Inside each strip, short arrows run left to right from inputs through a blue model box to outputs; between strips the reader moves top to bottom, then across the divider to (d).
insights.avoid: No arrow links strip (c) to the model in (d), and no training step or loss is drawn, so how the generated dataset trains InstructPix2Pix is left to the caption.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
